info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Rideshare Rides Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables the cancellation of rideshare rides centrally for enhanced management of ride operations. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can effectively remove rides from the active schedule, ensuring that resources are optimally allocated and unnecessary costs are minimized. It is particularly useful for rideshare service providers and fleet managers who need to manage their services dynamically. The endpoint supports efficient bulk cancellation processes, allowing businesses to seamlessly respond to changes in user requirements.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a previously scheduled ride. Upon successful cancellation, a confirmation response will be returned.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a ride. This payload allows the user to specify the necessary details to process the cancellation of a ride. Ensure that all required fields are properly filled to facilitate a successful cancellation.

200.description: The ride has been successfully canceled.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a ride operation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_200.title: Ride Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the ride after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the cancellation result.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for a successful ride cancellation operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier for the user or system that created the cancellation record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the cancellation record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information regarding the audit trail of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
